tool_input.command: for f in package.json index.html pigment.app.json README.md tests/smoke.spec.ts src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/components/*.tsx src/pages/*.tsx src/styles/base.css; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; done

cp design-packages/morning-shapes-0.1.0-rc.4/dist/tokens.css src/styles/tokens.css && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json'));p.dependencies['@fontsource/figtree']='^5.2.0';p.dependencies['@fontsource/dm-mono']='^5.2.0';fs.writeFileSync('package.json',JSON.stringify(p,null,2)+'\n')" && npm install 2>&1 | tail -3 && ls node_modules/@fontsource/figtree | head
tool_input.description: Copy tokens and install self-hosted fonts
